description: This file contains unit tests for custom grain placement strategies in an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes test setup classes, configuration details, and multiple test cases verifying placement behaviors such as fixed silo, exclusion, request context-based, and hash-based placement.

classes.name: CustomPlacementTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for verifying custom grain placement strategies in Orleans.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture that sets up the Orleans test cluster with custom placement configurations.

classes.name: TestSiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures individual silos to assume homogeneity and adds custom placement director.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with initial silos count and custom silo configurator.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures silo messaging options and adds placement director services.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Adds the custom placement director service to the DI container.

methods.name: CustomPlacement_FixedSilo
methods.description: Tests that grains are placed on a fixed silo as specified in the configuration.

methods.name: CustomPlacement_ExcludeOne
methods.description: Ensures grains are not placed on a specified excluded silo.

methods.name: CustomPlacement_RequestContextBased
methods.description: Verifies placement based on request context targeting a specific silo.

methods.name: HashBasedPlacement
methods.description: Tests hash-based placement ensuring grains are assigned according to their hash code.
